before.title: Aurelia 1978 launch campaign and Logix Computer Academy — execution
before.description: Communicate the launch, qualify demonstrations and coordinate follow-up described by the source campaign.

outcomes.description: Attractively edited broadcast feature with a clear business-user narrative
Short station-ready news packages and demonstration excerpts
Clean footage, separate narration/audio where practical, accurate captions and a factual product/Academy press sheet
Full edited presentations for stations wanting longer technical coverage

steps.description: Cinematic TV commercial and explanatory print advertisements; prioritise markets with demonstration, support and Academy coverage.
Coordinate the teaser, advertising, press and dealer preparation, then the nested NCC launch, technical sessions and media activities.

Target 10–15 pilot businesses and several accounting practices; reconcile results against existing records. Validate representative data volumes, disk/RAM budgets, posting, corrections, backup/restore and supported payroll jurisdictions before launch claims.

Qualify all advertised launch modules and a modest summary export to Abacus. Train instructors and dealers, publish requirements and support boundaries, and prepare a joint press preview. Measured capacity and final jurisdiction coverage remain acceptance gates, not invented results.

Begin BPI dealer qualification and accountant demonstration access, permission-based case studies and defined paid setup assistance. Each initial Academy centre has access to a BPI specialist; recruit or train ahead of demand.

Run year-end preparation workshops and module-upgrade demonstrations. Specify payroll update coverage and maintenance terms. Customer data remains under customer control; referrals do not imply an accountant endorsement without consent.

Expand demonstrations and qualified support using verified customer results. Promote module-to-suite upgrade credit. BPI Model II support is a separate future negotiation; the existing Tandy agreement covers Abacus only.
broadcast program / scope: Every Logix presentation at NCC 1978, including the premiere, both technical sessions, partner appearances, questions and any additional Logix sessions.

broadcast program / production: Professional multi-camera crew with clean presenter audio, audience/reaction coverage and close-ups of the computer, screen, connections and printouts. Retain full-session recordings and production masters.

broadcast program / distribution: Offer and supply the material free of charge to any television station wishing to broadcast it; Logix covers normal duplication and dispatch. Supply station-compatible broadcast copies on request.
broadcast program / broadcast fee usd: 0

broadcast program / editorial policy: Station participation, scheduling and editorial selection are voluntary; no guaranteed airtime, compulsory advertising purchase or claimed editorial endorsement. Identify the material as supplied by Logix.

broadcast program / rights: Arrange presenter, partner, music and production rights covering free television redistribution before recording. Michael Douglas commercial footage may be included only if separately cleared for this use.

broadcast program / fidelity: Do not accelerate startup or recalculation, conceal failures through misleading cuts, or present pre-recorded footage as a live result. Identify edited excerpts and show only qualified claims.

broadcast program / timing: Record throughout June 5–8; begin station outreach before NCC and distribute edited packages after the conference as edits and broadcast clearances are completed. Exact delivery dates and runtime remain production decisions.

broadcast program / engineering: Qualify a custom Aurelia digital-video-to-projection/recording path; rehearse readability, lighting and sound in the hired room. Use a backup demonstration system and clearly identified recorded fallback.
Post-NCC 1978 recording, editing and television distribution

change.title: Nest the NCC campaign in Aurelia Foundation and align their completion
change.reason: Add process.ncc1978_campaign as a subprocess and extend the foundation to its current end, 15 January 1979. Use the resolved calendar date because process boundaries support dates or events, and the campaign remains the sole owner of event.bpi_expansion. If that event later moves, update this matching date too. Remove the redundant qualification event reference and the BPI launch’s former direct placement, preserving substantive qualification actions.

before.title: Aurelia Foundation and Partnerships
before.description: Establish the commercial and partnership foundation for Aurelia: CP/M implementation, cooperation with independent BPI Systems, printer-mechanism supply, ComputerLand distribution and Academy support. This process includes the former BPI pilot and launch qualification work through June 1978.

inputs.description: The established DRI partnership enables the Aurelia CP/M implementation agreement that starts this process.
Logix and AION provide the product, engineering and distribution organisation needed to negotiate and carry out the Aurelia partnerships.

outcomes.description: Aurelia has a partnership foundation covering CP/M implementation, OEM printer mechanisms, ComputerLand distribution and Academy support, as documented in the constituent events.

BPI pilot testing, launch qualification and dealer/instructor preparation support the launch of its independently owned Aurelia applications. Qualification gates and support limits remain those recorded in the milestones; BPI has accepted Adam’s investment and AION’s C/TUI redevelopment obligations, with future-platform work and a subsequent BPI share-buyback right.

change.title: Group Apple’s business-market response into one process
change.reason: Use the earliest response event as period.start and the latest as period.end; place the other three dated events in chronological steps. Include the Aurelia launch as the causal input. Preserve all existing event dates, agreement states and market-response records.

after.title: Apple business-market response to Logix and AION
after.description: Apple responds to the Aurelia launch and AION business software by organising business-software recruitment, selective dealer demonstrations, partner searches, Peachtree cooperation and promotion of complete Apple II business configurations. This process covers the recorded response from July 1978 to April 1979 without assuming a finished software package or nationwide dealer rollout.

participant.role: organiser of the competitive business-software and dealer response

inputs.description: The Aurelia launch and its integrated business-software demonstrations prompt Apple to strengthen its own software partnerships and business-dealer offering.

steps.description: Prepare selective business-dealer demonstrations, complete-system quotations and introductory customer lessons.
Expand the business-software initiative into searches and negotiations for independent accounting, spreadsheet and database partners.
Pursue the recorded Apple–Peachtree accounting cooperation while continuing separate spreadsheet and database efforts; retain the agreement’s existing negotiation status.

outcomes.description: Apple has organised a coordinated response encompassing business-software recruitment, selective dealer demonstrations, Peachtree accounting cooperation and complete-configuration promotions. These activities establish no guaranteed sales, finished spring-1979 package or nationwide training network.
